note: SITE-156. One row per landed Yui on the web story, drawn on /web as 'What works so far'. `card` is the progress.json card key: the title and the link come from that entry. Shots are the same screen on a phone (390 px) and in a browser (desktop), `light` and `dark`; a missing theme falls back to the other. A new story adds one row here, newest last.

rows.label: Sign in

rows.say: Your agents in a column, the thread beside them, like the phone.

rows.label: Stage

rows.label: Composer
